summary: E2E browser verification of the 8-bug batch (Aurem QA regression fix spec, 2026-09-17). Verified live in preview env at https://bin-context-pat.preview.emergentagent.com. Bugs #3, #7, #8 verified live in browser. Bugs #4, #5, #6 verified via source-code review + existing unit tests (11 pytest tests pass). Bugs #1, #2 skipped (no live GitHub-connected fix-loop project available in this pod, and #2 requires controlling LLM output). No regressions detected.

This BLOCKS live E2E verification of Bug #4 (markdown rendering via a real assistant reply), Bug #5 (parallel-codegen '1 agent' text), and Bug #6 (scan result persisted to chat). Not a regression from this batch — pre-existing environment state.

verification_details.bug_3_approval_without_diff: PASS (live). Dashboard /dashboard renders [data-testid=ship-cto-1-approve-btn] alongside [data-testid=ship-no-diff-yet-1] with text 'No diff to review yet — the code is written after you approve, then checked and shown here before it's pushed.'. Page innerText contains NO 'second reviewer' and NO 'double-checked' misleading copy. Maxx chip's title attribute correctly reads 'no separate second-reviewer pass'. Source: frontend/src/components/ShipDialog.jsx lines 97-117.
verification_details.bug_4_nested_markdown: PASS (code review + unit tests). RenderedMessage.jsx (lines 194-256) implements _safeHref regex allowing only https?|mailto|/|# schemes (correctly blocks javascript:), and matches image-in-link '[![alt](src)](href)' BEFORE bare-link fallback in a single split-regex, preventing the truncation. Unit test frontend/src/components/__tests__/RenderedMessage.bug4_nested_link_2026_09_17.test.jsx already passes. Live browser trigger not possible in this env (chat 403 — see integration issue above).
verification_details.bug_5_pluralization: PASS (code review + unit tests). backend/services/plural_utils.py::pluralize returns '1 agent' for count=1 and 'N agents' otherwise. worker_api.py lines 472-475 correctly route through it. pytest tests/test_bug5_pluralization_2026_09_17.py — 3/3 passed.
verification_details.bug_6_scan_persisted_to_chat: PASS (code review). backend/routers/codebase_health.py lines 313-332 correctly calls services.ora_chat.session.append_message with role='assistant', route='scan-result', session_id sourced from request body — best-effort, wrapped in try/except so scan response never breaks. Live browser trigger not possible (chat 403).
verification_details.bug_7_title_consistency: PASS (live). Titles observed by navigating routes: Landing -> 'ORA by Aurem — The AI Engineer That Actually Commits | $9/mo'; /bug-hunt -> 'Bug Hunt — Detect 50+ vulnerabilities in your codebase | ORA by Aurem'; /vs/cursor -> 'ORA vs Cursor (2026) — honest comparison | Cursor alternative'; /codebase-health -> 'Codebase Health — ORA by Aurem'; navigating BACK to / restores 'ORA by Aurem — The AI Engineer That Actually Commits | $9/mo'. No stale title carry-over observed. Note: /analytics does not set a page-specific title (minor design issue above).
verification_details.bug_8_failure_taxonomy_analytics: PASS (live). /analytics as admin user renders 'TASK HEALTH' card with Completed 12 / Failed 122 / Maxx mode 0 / New users/wk 33; a 'FAILED — BY REASON' subsection appears underneath with 'unknown: 122'. [data-testid=analytics-failed-by-reason] present in DOM. Reason counts sum to failed total. No render errors. pytest tests/test_bug8_failure_taxonomy_2026_09_17.py — 8/8 passed.

critical_code_review_comments: RenderedMessage.jsx (Bug #4) — _safeHref allows relative paths '/' and fragment '#' which is standard; javascript:/data: correctly rejected. Regex ordering (image-in-link before bare-image before bare-link) is load-bearing — a comment already documents this. Good.
ShipDialog.jsx (Bug #3) — the no-diff disclosure sits INSIDE the idle branch only; on shipping/shipped states the TaskProgressCard replaces it as intended. No dead-code branch.

codebase_health.py (Bug #6) — persist path is best-effort inside try/except and only fires when session_id present. Correct. Frontend must pass session_id in the request body — verified via grep in ChatPanel.jsx wiring.
